sequential_dependency.intermediate: The run start depth and run length; for this case crop_depth=3 and run_length=3.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Find the earliest longest constant-color run among the effective strip rows.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Use the selected depth to discard the outer layers, then fold the remaining suffix into concentric square frames.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The selected run start determines both the output side length and which strip color becomes the outer frame; choosing no crop produces a different full 26x26 square.

parametric_work.summary: Matched-input full/longest-run-core adapter with two-demo finite-rival identification, four distinct queries, protected labels, sequential public views, and executable causal replay.

target.summary: Authored and self-reviewed a complete nested-strip public family with canonical full folding and an input-dependent longest-run-core branch.
